column1: # kind_tree.tsv -- the food-kind TREE over the kind tokens of kinds.tsv
# (kit_life.sh food-kind / dining-history); venue_facts.py does not read it.
# A preference is held at a node and scoped down its subtree; the deeper node
# wins (a like at spicy>mala survives a dislike at spicy). So every kind token
# kinds.tsv can produce must sit here exactly once, under ONE parent: the
# parent is the axis the owner's words group it by (mala is "spicy" before it
# is "chinese"; the cuisine is carried separately in column 3).
# Format: <node> TAB <parent or -> TAB <cuisine node or -> TAB <label> TAB <category words or ->
#   node      ascii token (= a kinds.tsv kind for dish/menu nodes)
#   parent    the node above it; '-' = a root
#   cuisine   the cuisine root this node belongs to ('-' = none by itself:
#             a shabu dish says nothing about the cuisine, the venue's own
#   label     owner-facing word, the element of food-kind "path"
#   words     comma list of place-page CATEGORY words that name this node
